preconditions.description: The number of people n must be between 1 and 200.
The number of friendships m must be at least n-1 and at most 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship must connect two distinct people within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(b in {0, 1} for i, j, b in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship must have a valid direction indicator b, which is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: The output must indicate whether a capitalist society is possible.
If the output is 'YES', it must include the maximum income inequality and the income assignments.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 10**6 for a_i in incomes)
postconditions.description: All assigned incomes must be within the range of 0 to 1,000,000.
The calculated income inequality must match the reported maximum income inequality.
